articles.availability_note: ESA released DR1-Foundation on November 12, 2026, from observations gathered in 2024–2025. More than a billion objects, 900 million galaxies, 60 million quasar candidates, 15,000 lens candidates and 160 million spectral sources are distinct, potentially overlapping categories. Spectra are inputs to distance measurements; this release is a foundation for mapping rather than a finished 3D map or a solution to dark matter. The 14% figure refers to intended survey area. Figures and superlatives are ESA reports; underlying catalogues were not independently reanalysed here.

articles.availability_note: The November 12 agreement is provisional and requires endorsement, legal revision, formal adoption and later implementing rules. Roughly 121 million allowances comprise about 88 million plus 28 million and a targeted 5 million set-aside; these are quantities for the 2026–2030 arrangement, not annual cash grants, observed emissions or an established increase in the overall cap. The 28 million originated in unallocated allowances linked to unmet conditions; the release does not establish a blanket waiver. Eligibility, allocation, competitiveness and emissions outcomes remain separate tests.

articles.availability_note: Catch-up addition first published November 17, 2026 (Hong Kong time). NASA’s November 13, 2026 retrospective concerns the November 1966 Gemini XII flight. Mercury and Gemini photography contributed to the case for Earth observation; Pecora’s 1969 account dates EROS conception to 1966. The particular Nile image’s role in a specific decision remains uncertain. Landsat launched in 1972 and provides a connected observation history; usable observations vary by sensor, date, location and conditions. River and growth-chart examples explain measurement and interpretation. The cover is an original conceptual illustration.

articles.availability_note: 补充报道，首次发布于2026年11月17日（香港时间）。NASA于2026年11月13日发表的回顾，讲述1966年11月双子座十二号飞行。水星与双子座摄影曾帮助推动地球观测倡议；佩科拉在1969年将EROS构想追溯至1966年。尼罗河照片对某一次决策的具体作用仍待历史记录确认。陆地卫星于1972年启程，长期记录的可用范围随传感器、时间、地点和观测条件而异。河流与身高尺例子用于解释观测方法和解读。封面为原创概念插画。
